paragraphs.text: Hedgehog is a creature type for cards that depict small nocturnal mammals with a spiny coat and short legs, able to roll themselves into a ball for defense.

Only 3 hedgehogs have been printed so far in red-white , black-red , and blue-red-white , respectively. Consequently, they don't have a standard color in which they appear, though this may change in the future.

Hedgehog debuted as a Universes Beyond creature type in Secret Lair Drop Series: Sonic Superdrop for the characters of Sonic The Hedgehog , Shadow the Hedgehog , and Amy Rose from the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise.
Hedgehogs have been depicted on cards from Lorwyn and Dominiaria . Hedgehog-folk have only appeared on Bloomburrow as part of the wider array of animal-folk.
